review.notes: Triage review. (a) Structural scan over all 1555 lines: the OCR Markdown contains no code fences at all, so fence balance and fence-swallowed headings/tables/images cannot occur; 84 headings and 32 image embeds verified present. (b) Machine droppage scan over all 111 physical pages: normalized 4-gram set containment per PDF page (26 pages below 0.92 hit inspected individually) plus a 5-gram prose-line scan; every low-hit page was explained as an HTML table reflow (Tables 1, 2, 8, 14, 20-34, language table on physical pages 14-15, appendix data tables on pages 108-109 all present with their numeric bodies), LaTeX math restructuring, or figure-internal text of embedded figures (pages 54, 57, 60, 62 chart pages are embedded as images). Targeted probes confirmed footnotes of physical pages 51-52, the model card bullets of pages 110-111, BLASER 2.0 mentions (91), and reference spot checks (Wahlster, Fleurs, CVSS, Billion-scale). (c) Visual verification on rendered physical pages 5 and 71 (300 dpi crops; full page 5 at 110 dpi). Not line-by-line: main narrative reflow was accepted from the page-level gram scan rather than a full manual read; references (pages 74-84) were only spot-checked. The 11 backslash-underscore escapes inside printed URLs/DOIs (e.g. 10.1162/tacl\_a\_00288 on page 86) were left unchanged because the print really shows underscores and \_ renders as _, so the visible text is faithful. Small caps HOLISTICBIAS on page 71 matches the rendered small-caps print and was left unchanged.

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.5 (300 dpi crop, visually read) prints the small-caps name as AUDIOPALM-2-8B- (hyphenated, wrapping to AST on the next line); the same document's Table 2 on physical p.6 prints AudioPaLM-2-8B-AST and the OCR table cell on that page already reads AudioPaLM-2-8B-AST. OCR dropped the hyphens only in this prose mention.

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.71 (300 dpi crop, visually read) prints "...in a particular axis—such is the case for Bengali (80% socio-economic status)..."; OCR misread the printed 'is' as 'as', silently paraphrasing the sentence.

unresolved.evidence: Reference entries were only spot-checked (Wahlster, Fleurs, CVSS, Billion-scale similarity search all present); the eleven \\_-escaped URL/DOI strings in this range render faithfully and were left, but a character-level read of every entry has not been done.

Pages 54, 57, 60 and 62 are chart pages whose text exists only inside figure images embedded in the Markdown; their axis labels are not transcribed, which is correct for embedded figures, so no patch applies.
